Results.ReviewText:
This is a great little grill for cooking up to eight burgers or lots of hot dogs at a time. I’ve also had success with salmon, pork chops, corn, and vegetables in a tray.

There are a few drawbacks, including it isn’t quite large enough use my standard veggie tray while cooking anything other than dogs/sausage. This is because the tray’s handles touch the curved top, and the only way it closes is when the tray is in the center, leaning little grill space around the perimeter for other items. Of course, this is meant to be a small portable grill, so it’s an acceptable compromise.

My main struggle is with controlling the heat for slower cooking. I think the challenge is the burners are close to the grill, so even on the lowest setting the grill surface is quite hot, leading to more charring unless I flip frequently. This has mainly been a problem when cooking skinless chicken with marinades.

All-in-all, it is a great little portable grill, but at home I prefer my Spirit II due to the larger cook surface, better lid geometry, and better control over the surface heat.

ClientResponses.Response:
Hello, we are very sorry to hear about this issue.It sounds like you may be activating a safety device built into the regulator. To ensure that you are not inadvertently activating the safety device as you turn on the grill, please use the following procedure:



-Turn all burner control knobs to OFF, including the side burner control knob if present.



-Make sure the grill lid is open. Open the LP tank valve and then wait at least 60 seconds. This will allow the hose and regulator to pressurize.



-Turn the appropriate burner control knob for your model grill to the START/HIGH position and then ignite the grill by pushing the ignition button.



-Turn each of the other burner control knobs to high, one at a time, and press the igniter button (if applicable for your model). Repeat this process until all the burners have been lit.



-Close the grill lid.



-The grill should reach approximately 500 to 550 degrees in 10-15 minutes.

This is how you would want to start the grill each time. If you continue to have issues after going through these steps please contact our support team. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Go hiking in nature with a grill as vibrant as the scenery. Travel on or off the beaten path, camp in the woods or near the shore. Explore the world with big taste and your Q 1200 portable gas grill by your side.


NOTE: Can accommodate a full-size, 20 lb. fuel tank when using an  adapter hose
